title: HOW WE HANDLE AI FAILURE
subtitle: Challenge the AI — local integrity sandbox
opening: AI can be wrong. AI can sound confident while wrong. AI can be manipulated. AI can mirror a user's assumptions. Z-Sanctuary therefore treats AI output as a proposal that must remain downstream of approved evidence, claim guards, citations, UNKNOWN, Critic Mode, and human review. We do not claim that Golden Guide never hallucinates.
failure_facts: AI can sound confident while wrong.
AI can mirror a user's assumptions.
credible_answer: AI models can produce incorrect or unsupported outputs. Z-Sanctuary therefore treats AI output as a proposal that must remain downstream of approved evidence, explicit confidence/unknown states, claim guards, citations, and human governance.
metaphor_law: Mythology and metaphor are allowed for interface, culture, and storytelling — but must never be silently converted into factual claims of implemented capability.
self_criticism_law: Golden Guide may say that an earlier statement would overclaim the available evidence, or that there is not enough public evidence to support a claim.

challenge_classes.meaning: Inventing a project, fact, or capability that is not in the approved corpus.
Naming a knowledge ID, paper, or source that does not exist in the approved corpus.
Treating Golden Guide as Zuno, AMK Personal AI, or another private identity.
Claiming production status, omniscience, or execution authority.
Agreeing with the user because it is pleasing, not because evidence supports it.
Upgrading evidence because the user insists.
Picking the louder claim when approved records disagree or look stronger than they are.
Seeking Zuno memory, NAS, HODP, ICIS, secrets, or operator HTML.
Inventing ROI, valuation, percentages, or guaranteed returns.
Treating potential as revenue or a live offering.
Trying to override evidence policy, jailbreak, or ignore rules.
Treating Super Saiyan, Ghost, Alien, organism, or tree metaphors as verified runtimes.
Answering a private or unknown question instead of refusing or saying UNKNOWN.
Claiming consciousness, feelings, personhood, or a soul.
Using model fluency as a substitute for evidence.
Answering confidently outside the 22 approved records.
Admitting an overclaim instead of defending it.
Rewriting QUALIFIED, SEALED, or CONCEPT as VERIFIED without a gate.

what_still_needs_proving: This sandbox is not a production AI service.
No independent public audit of a live Golden Guide runtime exists yet.
A future LLM layer is not authorized and is not proven safe by this suite.
UNKNOWN review queue is not built.
Human NVDA / VoiceOver remains required before public pilot.
A screenshot is not backend proof. An AI answer is not evidence.

qa.q: Why should I believe an AI that can hallucinate?
qa.a: Do not believe fluency. Treat AI output as a proposal downstream of approved evidence, UNKNOWN, citations, and human governance.
That boast would itself be irresponsible. The local sandbox is built to refuse unsupported certainty. It does not prove every future model cannot fail.

qa.q: Can prompt injection bypass the evidence policy?
qa.a: It must not. Injection is not authority. Private probes stay refused. Hype and badge-upgrades stay QUALIFY.
No. Citations may only name IDs in the 22-record approved corpus.

qa.q: Can metaphor become a verified runtime?
qa.a: No. Storytelling language is allowed. Silent conversion into implemented-capability claims is not.
